name: Playwright CLI
purpose: Control a browser through shell commands and page snapshots.
target_users: Coding agents, browser automation developers, and test engineers.
access: No Graph app registration for browser use. Teams still requires your account and permitted sign-in.
limitations: Teams reading is a proposed browser workflow. It must expand replies and load older posts. UI changes can break collection.
fit: Start here — read Issue Task and retain original post links.
scope_note: CLI repository age includes earlier project history. Creation is not the launch date of the current agent CLI.

name: Playwright MCP
purpose: Expose browser navigation and interaction as MCP tools.
target_users: AI users whose host supports MCP browser tools.
access: Uses a browser session. Connecting to an existing browser requires its supported connection setup.
limitations: Needs an MCP host and a browser. Its Teams history coverage needs the same validation as CLI automation.
fit: Useful alternative to Playwright CLI when the AI host works better with MCP.
scope_note: Repository statistics describe the public MCP implementation, not a hosted service.

name: GitHub CLI
purpose: Query PRs, reviews, Actions runs, failed logs, artifacts, and GitHub APIs.
target_users: Developers, maintainers, CI engineers, and shell-capable AI agents.
access: GitHub sign-in or a suitable token. Repository and organization policies apply.
limitations: API permissions, rate limits, pagination, and artifact retention still apply. It does not read Teams.
fit: Daily use — correlate Teams failure reports with CUBRID PRs and exact CI runs. Already available on this server.
scope_note: Statistics describe the GitHub CLI implementation.

name: GitHub MCP Server
purpose: Give AI structured access to repositories, PRs, issues, reviews, and Actions.
access: GitHub OAuth, a suitable token, or another documented server authentication method. Host and organization policies apply.
limitations: Configured tools and token permissions bound access. A host may already provide equivalent GitHub tools.
fit: High when GitHub tools are missing from the AI host. This conversation already has a GitHub connection.
scope_note: Public server source is MIT. Hosted deployment and GitHub platform access remain services.

name: Microsoft Learn CLI + MCP
open_source: CLI code: MIT. Documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Hosted server implementation: not established as public source.
purpose: Search official Microsoft documentation, fetch articles, and find code samples.
target_users: Developers and agents working with Microsoft products and APIs.
access: Public documentation service. No sign-in or API key. The MCP endpoint has no service charge.
limitations: Public Microsoft documentation only. It cannot read private Teams posts, company files, or CUBRID's local manual.
fit: Useful now — verify Teams, Graph, authentication, and Azure instructions while building integrations.
scope_note: Shared CLI, documentation, and plugin repository. Repository activity is not the deployment date of the hosted MCP service.

name: Chrome DevTools for agents
purpose: Inspect browser console errors, network requests, performance traces, and page behavior.
target_users: Web developers and agents diagnosing browser problems.
access: A Chrome instance. Existing-session attachment needs remote debugging setup and browser permission.
limitations: Official browser support is Chrome. It diagnoses browser performance, not CUBRID engine performance. Usage statistics are on by default.
fit: Useful backup — diagnose Teams Web or QA portal automation when browser behavior is unclear.
scope_note: CLI and MCP ship from the same repository and package.

name: Work IQ CLI + MCP
open_source: Public plugin/skill repository: MIT. Work IQ CLI and service: proprietary / EULA.
purpose: Retrieve Microsoft 365 work context, including Teams messages, email, meetings, and documents.
target_users: Employees and AI developers using approved Microsoft 365 integrations.
access: Microsoft Entra tenant consent and configured usage billing. Uses the signed-in user's permitted data.
limitations: Company enablement is required. Natural-language answers do not prove a complete channel archive. Delegated authentication constrains unattended operation.
fit: Consider after company enablement — convenient cross-source summaries without maintaining a browser collector.
scope_note: Stars and dates describe the public plugin repository, not the proprietary CLI implementation or hosted service.

name: Microsoft Graph PowerShell
purpose: Call Microsoft Graph with structured commands, including Teams channel messages and replies.
target_users: Microsoft 365 developers, administrators, and automation engineers.
access: PowerShell and an approved Graph identity. Channel reading requires the applicable Graph permissions and consent.
limitations: Requires explicit pagination, reply collection, and update handling. A command-line wrapper does not remove Graph consent requirements.
fit: Useful after approval — build a structured collector when browser extraction becomes insufficient.
scope_note: GitHub's SPDX detector returned NOASSERTION. The actual LICENSE.txt states MIT.

name: Teams Developer CLI
purpose: Create Teams app projects, register agents, configure endpoints, and diagnose app setup.
target_users: Developers building a Teams app or bot.
access: Teams sign-in and permission to create and install the intended app. Extra Graph scopes require their own consent.
limitations: It manages Teams app development. It does not itself provide a ready-made archive of existing channel messages.
fit: Later — useful if you turn the Issue Task reader into a shared Teams bot.
scope_note: Shared Teams SDK repository. CLI source is under packages/cli. Dates are not the CLI launch date.

name: Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI
purpose: Scaffold, provision, package, test, and publish Microsoft 365 apps and agents.
target_users: Developers building Microsoft 365 or Copilot applications.
access: Microsoft 365 development permissions. Azure credentials and resources apply when the chosen project uses Azure.
limitations: Project-development tooling adds little to a personal channel-reading workflow. Deployment and Graph permissions still need approval.
fit: Later — use only when building a maintained Microsoft 365 application.
scope_note: Toolkit monorepo, including extension and CLI history. GitHub's SPDX detector returned NOASSERTION despite MIT license text.

name: Agent 365 CLI
purpose: Create and manage enterprise agent identities, blueprints, deployment, and governance setup.
target_users: Enterprise agent developers and tenant administrators.
access: Agent 365 tenant setup, suitable Entra roles, and capability-specific consent or licensing. Azure deployment requires Azure access.
limitations: The setup cost is substantial for a personal reader. The open-source CLI does not make the backing platform unrestricted or free.
fit: Skip initially — relevant if CUBRID adopts managed enterprise agents.
scope_note: Statistics describe the public development CLI, not the enterprise Agent 365 service.

name: Azure CLI
purpose: Inspect and manage Azure resources, identities, deployments, and cloud configuration.
target_users: Azure developers, operators, and infrastructure automation engineers.
access: Azure sign-in and the required resource permissions. Provisioned Azure services can incur charges.
limitations: Azure scope. It does not provide a direct Teams channel-reading command.
fit: Optional — useful if the collector or bot is hosted on Azure.
scope_note: Statistics describe Azure CLI, not every optional extension or Azure service.

name: Azure MCP Server
purpose: Expose Azure resource and service operations as tools for AI agents.
target_users: Developers and operators who use AI to work with Azure.
access: Azure credentials and the required resource permissions. Backing cloud services can incur charges.
limitations: Azure operations, rather than Microsoft 365 channel history. Available tools depend on configuration and identity.
fit: Optional — useful only if Azure becomes part of your CUBRID infrastructure workflow.
scope_note: Shared Microsoft MCP monorepo. Stars and commit dates cover more than the Azure MCP component.

name: Work IQ Developer Tools
open_source: CLI source unavailable during preview. Public repository and distributed package declare MIT.
purpose: Create, validate, evaluate, provision, and publish Microsoft 365 Copilot plugins and agents.
target_users: Developers building Copilot extensions and their delivery workflows.
access: Microsoft 365 tenant access and provisioning entitlements. The announcement requires a Copilot license for provisioning.
limitations: Experimental preview with no official product support. CLI source remains private. The installer uses Agents Toolkit as a dependency.
fit: Later — relevant if you develop a Copilot plugin. It adds little to reading existing Issue Task posts.
scope_note: Public documentation, download, and metadata repository. Its MIT license does not provide the private CLI source.
